prompt: A split-composition legal illustration centered around a glowing, monumental set of justice scales inside a solemn courtroom, visually demonstrating the balance between a minor unlawful act and an imminent catastrophe. On one weighing pan sits a small, broken padlock and a clipped chain-link fence labeled as a minor trespass, while on the opposite, dramatically heavier pan rests a massive, looming disaster—a volatile, overheating technological reactor threatening immediate destruction. In the foreground, a defendant in activist attire gestures toward the catastrophic threat to justify their breach of the perimeter, presenting evidence of the averted crisis to an attentive jury. Above the scene, a stern judge wields a gavel alongside a glowing hourglass symbolizing the strict legal threshold of immediate versus distant harm, clearly conveying the principle of breaking a minor law as a last resort to prevent an overwhelming, urgent peril.
